note: v1856: Konyo asked whether the focus could be worked out from one photo instead of declared or paid for. It already could: chronicle_template.detect resolves the tab from four independent pixel signals and reports how many voted - and nothing outside its own test had ever called it, while every candidate run paid a model to answer the same question. Measured on his frames: uniques 4 of 4, sets 4 of 4, console window 1 of 4, gameplay 1 of 4, stash 0 of 4. The model stays as the fallback when it abstains.
